payload.title: 阶段③ 结构 gate（真实 latent 管线）：locus=A，非 B；AB 无增益；选 A-only

payload.scope: Full latent-pipeline structural gate for A+ (RSHC-TK): A/B/AB low-rank context modulation on real PatchTST-Koopman pipeline, P2 data, 2 seeds

deployed_anchor_edmd_P4.note: comparable to end-to-end fixed -> baseline valid

falsification_seed0.note: modulation-off and uh-history-zero both degrade H20 by ~11-13x -> gain is from modulation itself and depends on input history

verdicts.locus_is_A_not_B: CONFIRMED - A-only -73.7%/-74.3% (2 seeds); B-only ~0 or worse at long horizon; contradicts round-11 observation-space proxy inference
verdicts.AB_vs_A_only: no gain (73.3% vs 73.7% seed0; 71.7% vs 74.3% seed1) -> choose A-only
verdicts.why_not_transferable: observation-space proxy d=J(phi)u can only modulate the input channel; latent A acts on z=[x;h] with h encoding history -> A(c) expresses history-dependent latent dynamics
verdicts.falsification: PASS - gain from modulation (modOFF collapses) + uses input history (uhZERO collapses)

payload.open: boundedness/stability of modulation (needed for DEC-018), rank-r sensitivity, latent matched-state, CB(c) spectrum/PD, cross-sample history-shuffle
